| EfficientDet-Lite2 | host_reference_upper | INT8 | 448x448 | 5.524 M | 7.52 MB | 3.37 G | KITTI tracking static segments (test, original frames) | 712 | 10555 | 36220 | 0.240 | 0.078 | 133.4 | NOT MEASURED |

* **Host-reference detectors** (MediaPipe EfficientDet-Lite0/Lite2, SSD-MobileNetV2; Apache-2.0, COCO-trained, SHA-256 pinned) are NOT MCU-class. VOC results use the COCO->VOC class map without fine-tuning; KITTI results map Car->car and Pedestrian->person.
* MACs: conv/depthwise/FC multiply-accumulates from the TFLite graph (MediaPipe models) or thop (TinyissimoYOLO, PyTorch graph at 256x256).
* Host latency: shared 4-core cloud container CPU, 1 inference thread, with other jobs running concurrently for most rows; treat host latencies as indicative only. **No Portenta H7 latency has been measured for any model.**
